newsitem.title: CHINA: China light industry output seen up 15 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China light industry output seen up 15 pct in 1997.

text.p: The gross output value of China's light industry is expected to hit 3.01 trillion yuan ($363 billion) in 1997, up 15 percent from 2.62 trillion yuan last year, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Saturday.

The light industry sector was expected to chalk up added value of 730 billion yuan this year, up 13 percent from 643 billion yuan in 1996, the newspaper quoted Yu Zhen, chairman of the General Association of Light Industry, as saying.
The value of exports of light industrial products was expected to rise 10 percent to $48 billion this year, from $44 billion in 1996, the newspaper said.
Pre-tax profits in the sector were expected to reach 44 billion yuan, with net profits of 3.0 billion yuan, it said.
The output value and export value of the light industry sector accounted for around one-third of total gross industrial output value and of total exports, official figures showed.
